verdict.line: You lose if you duel her against a wall full of Tentacles before level 6; you win once E or R can isolate her from the terrain for a clean fight.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's entire kit — her passive healing, her Q (Tentacle Smash) damage bonus, and the Vessel conversion on her E (Test of Spirit) — depends on nearby Tentacles growing on walls. Mordekaiser is the one top laner with two separate tools to strip that away: E (Death's Grasp) pulls her off the terrain, and R (Realm of Death) removes her from the map entirely. That's why Morde holds a 53.5% win rate over 1143 games here despite the matchup being even on paper.

theirWindow.when: She lands E near spawned tentacles
theirWindow.what: If the spirit she rips from you dies or you run too far from it, you become a Vessel and start spawning Tentacles for her — don't let this trade drag out next to walls; commit and finish the exchange fast.

yourWindow.when: R is up and she's off cooldown-free terrain
yourWindow.what: Realm of Death drags her into a separate dimension with you — no Tentacles follow. Use it the moment she's away from walls to force a 1v1 she can't buff with her kit.

start.why: Most-picked start in this matchup (53.9% WR, 79.1% pick) — the mana regen keeps Q and E spammable in extended poke trades, and the HP5/AP cushions her Tentacle chip damage.

boots.why: 77.8% pick for a reason — Illaoi's damage is almost entirely physical (her autos, W, and every Tentacle swing), and flat armor cuts all of it down.

core.why: The slow on-hit matters because her only gap closer is W's 400-range leap; once you can kite her, she has no way back in.
Omnivamp plus the ramping true damage sustains you through the long trades her passive-healing tentacles force, and stacks with W's shield-then-heal.
Burn scales with her tankiness if she builds into the fight, and she has no reliable way to disengage from the DoT once E or Q lands.

situational.when: she's out-sustaining you in extended duels off her passive healing
you need antiheal online before a full Thornmail completes
you're ahead and want to amplify your own W self-heal in skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: The most-run page here (54.9% WR, 53% pick) — Conqueror's ramping adaptive force rewards exactly the kind of prolonged melee trade this matchup becomes once you've pulled her off a wall.

summoners.why: 85.3% pick rate at 54.1% WR. Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into real kills in early trades; Flash lets you set up an E pull or dodge her W leap when she commits.

playing.title: Pull her off the wall
playing.detail: Use E (Death's Grasp, 700 range) to yank Illaoi away from nearby Tentacles before you commit to a trade — without them nearby she loses both her damage amp and her passive healing.

playing.title: Save R for isolation, not burst
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) removes both of you from the lane terrain entirely. Hold it until she's caught away from walls, then force the duel on ground with zero Tentacle assistance.

playing.title: Don't drag out her E
playing.detail: If she lands Test of Spirit, either finish the fight before the tether breaks or disengage completely — letting the spirit die or wandering too far turns you into a Vessel that spawns Tentacles against you.

playing.title: Land Q on her alone
playing.detail: Obliterate's damage is increased when it hits a single enemy, so in lane trades angle it to clip only Illaoi, not minions — it's up every 8s at rank 1, down to 4s at rank 5.

playing.title: Bank damage into W before healing
playing.detail: Indestructible stores both damage dealt and damage taken into a shield you consume to heal — trade autos and Q in first, then pop it, rather than healing reflexively on cooldown.

playing.title: Respect tentacle-assisted engages
playing.detail: When she lands W (Harsh Lesson) near a live Tentacle, that Tentacle also swings at you. Don't stand adjacent to spawned Tentacles once her Q is back up (10s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5) and empowering them.

playing.title: Walk the matchup, don't panic
playing.detail: This is a favoured lane for you (53.5% WR, 1143 games) with solo-kill advantage — you don't need to force anything before level 3; just don't fight her on her terrain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning tying them together — tentacle dependency, E/R isolation, trade timing — is my own read of the kit, not sourced data.
